scope: BAM benchmark results measure performance on controlled concrete NDT specimens. They are not evidence of soil/utility-scale subsurface detection or localisation performance.

grid.frame: benchmark-local; X along specimen length, Y across width, Z two-way time

dzt.why: The DZT trace count does not equal the coordinate-registered grid and no source documents the mapping; see benchmark.gates open question 'dzt-to-grid-mapping'.

detection.match_rule: a detection matches a target when its peak trace node lies within the target's footprint (grid nodes within one published outer radius of the published target X); no additional tolerance
detection.scope: BAM benchmark results measure performance on controlled concrete NDT specimens. They are not evidence of soil/utility-scale subsurface detection or localisation performance.

false_alarms.rate_basis: detections per line on attested-empty ground
false_alarms.control_caveat: Pk050 is not featureless. The step back walls are real reflectors at the step thicknesses above, and any detector will respond to them. It is a control for EMBEDDED OBJECTS, not a control for 'no reflector'.
false_alarms.per_area_note: not computed: the archives declare no physical unit for X/Y, so an area cannot be stated without assuming one
